title: Johnny Silverhand totem of undying
description: Changes the texture of the totem of undying to Johnny Silverhand.
body: This resource pack adds a cyberpunk twist to the totem of undying by making it look like Robert John Linder, a.k.a. Johnny Silverhand. Carry around your favourite rockstar in your offhand whilst your enjoy playing minecraft. This allows fans of the renowned game to enjoy their favourite story in a new way by giving a fresh look to a minecraft survival staple.
